arms.E: new spatial slot parser trained on fit-lineage frames, predictors retrained on its carriers
arms.R0: frozen issue-70 parser, predictors retrained on its carriers (same data and recipe)
arms.current: frozen #77 N1 checkpoints (#99 attribution stage c), reference only

claim_boundary: decision-only ranking of retained engine-verdicted executions on the 4 held-out N1 members (never fit here or by #77; exposed through earlier tickets); a new slot encoder and predictors trained on fit lineages of the same two families; no engine access, rendering or capture; no closed-loop or competence claim; every interval is DESCRIPTIVE

decision_rule.Q3_target: supported iff guards pass AND some request of arm E on held-out grid cells under the tie-free cost has AUC >= 0.65 with lower bound > 0.55; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff guards pass and no request does; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.Q4_encoder_effect: request-mean paired (E - R0) AUC on held-out grid cells, tie-free cost: supported iff mean >= 0.02 and lower > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff upper < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.multiplicity: Q3 scans 12 requests against one target; the count of requests meeting it is reported; held-out grid has 3 member clusters, whose percentile bootstrap has 10 distinct resamples and understates uncertainty

disclosure: Known before freeze: every #99 attribution table (all and held-out cohorts, including the current checkpoint's held-out stage-c AUCs under the tie-free cost, several of which already meet the target), the #96 and #109 tables. The encoder architecture and every training setting below were fixed without any held-out verdict join; the smoke joins no verdict.

encoder.adapter: issue-70 RepairedAdapter temperatures/thresholds and the 236-value carrier; relations and macros never enter the carrier tensor
encoder.loss: issue-70 repair.parser_loss with class-balanced pig/block presence weights from the training frames
encoder.targets: issue-70 repair.targets on the frame's engine sample: presence, projected centers, cohort-v2 micro relations, native macro labels

evaluation.cells: mixed held-out member x 3 seeds; inventories never pooled

costs.count: frozen TaskObjective: 1000 * clamp(pig presence, 0, 1) + sum over block slots of clamp(block presence, 0, 1)
costs.tie_free: pig presence (unclamped) - 0.1 * Euclidean displacement of the pig slot center (normalized screen units) between the stage's start carrier (position 0) and the endpoint carrier; lower is better

evaluation.endpoint_stage_ap: the arm's parsed endpoint frame -> cost, held-out shots (diagnostic)
evaluation.interval: member-clustered percentile bootstrap, 10000 draws, PCG64 7201, DESCRIPTIVE
evaluation.perception: outcome-free: parser presence (>= 0.5) against engine presence per slot kind at positions 0 and 225 of every held-out shot, per arm
evaluation.stage: c: the arm's parsed sealed anchor -> request rollout to 225 -> cost (m99.rollout_endpoints); requests the 9 hybrid and 3 continuous fixed pairs

fit_data.rule: every #77 N1 admissible branch of the #77 predictor/controller lineages plus every verdict-bearing #93/#94/#87/#89 inventory execution of those lineages; verdicts are never read by training

gate_a.q1_token_note: the attribution's Q1/Q2 tokens are readiness_or_precision_insufficient because its frozen G2 byte-identity guard failed on 4/859 decision frames; Gate A's dominant stage is computed independently of the guards and names the step-3 remedy

guards.G1: no training shot belongs to a held-out member
guards.G2: encoder finished every epoch and all 12 predictors reached the frozen step count with finite losses
guards.G3: R0 parsed endpoint costs (stage ap) replicate the #99 attribution endpoint records within 0.001
guards.G4: nonfinite share <= 0.1 on held-out grid cells for every arm and request

predictors.pairs: PAIRS[step % 9]; continuous uses the same horizon

prohibited: reading any held-out verdict before publish
changing the encoder, windows or recipe after training starts
re-opening any prior disposition (#15-#98, #109) or the #99 attribution
question: with the slot encoder replaced (the Gate-A remedy) and predictors retrained on its carriers, does any request's predicted cost order held-out grid candidates with AUC >= 0.65 and a lower bound > 0.55; and how much of the change is the encoder (E - R0)?
